entry.role: Real activation followed by four explicit calls to the real eight-fragment collector, then actual worker timeout and maintenance. Inputs advance software generations only. The collector is called directly; the submission branch and hardware crypto producer are not executed. Source validity flags remain zero, so the copy getter returns20 which this collector ignores.

memory.evidence: Explicit software RAM/stack handoff; not a hardware reset or peripheral result.
